entries.title: Ask your first mate to suggest a project's tags
entries.body: A project with no tags now shows Suggest tags in its Tags box in Settings → Projects. One press takes you home, where your first mate reads the project's open tasks and puts up one card of suggested tags, each with a description and example tasks. Reply to rename, add or drop suggestions; tick the ones you want, choose which existing tasks to check, and your first mate adds them and starts the check.

picture.alt: A project's empty Tags box in Settings, with Suggest tags before Add a tag and a line saying it asks your first mate, who answers on a card
